quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Deep"? (the middle of the ocean vs. a splashy wading pool)
quests.question: Deep
quests.hint: Think about where a diver would need special equipment to explore safely. What's the opposite of "Deep"?
quests.explanation: "Deep" means going down very far. "Shallow" means only going down a little way. Since those are completely different, Shallow is the opposite of Deep!
quests.funFact: The deepest part of the ocean is deeper than Mount Everest is tall!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Remember"? (a photo album full of memories vs. a name slipping your mind)
quests.question: Remember
quests.hint: Think about what you do when you write a note so you don't lose an idea. What's the opposite of "Remember"?
quests.explanation: "Remember" means to keep something in your mind. "Forget" means to let something slip out of your mind. Since those are completely different, Forget is the opposite of Remember!
quests.funFact: Writing something down helps your brain remember it much better!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Morning"? (the sun rising over rooftops vs. the sky turning orange at sunset)
quests.question: Morning
quests.hint: Think about when you eat breakfast compared to when you eat dinner. What's the opposite of "Morning"?
quests.explanation: "Morning" means the early part of the day. "Evening" means the later part of the day before night. Since those are completely different, Evening is the opposite of Morning!
quests.funFact: Roosters famously crow in the morning to greet the rising sun!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Strong"? (a champion weightlifter vs. a newborn kitten)
quests.question: Strong
quests.hint: Think about who could carry more grocery bags at once. What's the opposite of "Strong"?
quests.explanation: "Strong" means able to lift or carry a lot. "Weak" means not able to lift or carry much. Since those are completely different, Weak is the opposite of Strong!
quests.funFact: Ants are incredibly strong for their size and can lift many times their own weight!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Win"? (lifting a golden trophy vs. shaking hands after a defeat)
quests.question: Win
quests.hint: Think about what the team with the most points does at the end of the game. What's the opposite of "Win"?
quests.explanation: "Win" means to finish first in a game or contest. "Lose" means to not finish first in a game or contest. Since those are completely different, Lose is the opposite of Win!
quests.funFact: Even great athletes lose sometimes — practice is how they learn to win more!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Straight"? (a ruler-straight road vs. a wiggly mountain trail)
quests.question: Straight
quests.hint: Think about which path a train track usually follows across flat land. What's the opposite of "Straight"?
quests.explanation: "Straight" means going in one direction with no bends. "Crooked" means bending and turning many times. Since those are completely different, Crooked is the opposite of Straight!
quests.funFact: Lightning bolts zigzag because hot air makes their path bend and twist!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Give"? (handing a friend a present vs. grabbing a cookie from the jar)
quests.question: Give
quests.hint: Think about what you do with a birthday gift you picked out for a friend. What's the opposite of "Give"?
quests.explanation: "Give" means to hand something to someone. "Take" means to grab something for yourself. Since those are completely different, Take is the opposite of Give!
quests.funFact: Giving a gift to a friend often feels just as good as receiving one!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Expensive"? (a sparkling diamond ring vs. a penny toy from a machine)
quests.question: Expensive
quests.hint: Think about which item you would save your allowance for much longer to buy. What's the opposite of "Expensive"?
quests.explanation: "Expensive" means costs a lot of money. "Cheap" means costs very little money. Since those are completely different, Cheap is the opposite of Expensive!
quests.funFact: Some rare toys and cards can sell for more money than a car!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Start"? (a green traffic light vs. a red stop sign)
quests.question: Start
quests.hint: Think about what a red light tells cars to do. What's the opposite of "Start"?
quests.explanation: "Start" means to get something moving. "Stop" means to make something not move anymore. Since those are completely different, Stop is the opposite of Start!
quests.funFact: Traffic lights use red for stop because it's the easiest color to notice fast!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Early"? (the very first one at the bus stop vs. the last one running to catch it)
quests.question: Early
quests.hint: Think about what you'd call arriving before everyone else, not after. What's the opposite of "Early"?
quests.explanation: "Early" means before the expected time. "Late" means after the expected time. Since those are completely different, Late is the opposite of Early!
quests.funFact: The early bird really does catch the worm — worms come out at dawn!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Come"? (a puppy running toward you vs. a puppy running away)
quests.question: Come
quests.hint: Think about what you'd call to your dog to make it run toward you. What's the opposite of "Come"?
quests.explanation: "Come" means to move toward a place. "Go" means to move away from a place. Since those are completely different, Go is the opposite of Come!
quests.funFact: Birds that fly south for winter always come back again in spring!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Smooth"? (a polished glass marble vs. a bumpy piece of tree bark)
quests.question: Smooth
quests.hint: Think about how a slide feels compared to how sandpaper feels. What's the opposite of "Smooth"?
quests.explanation: "Smooth" means even, with no bumps at all. "Rough" means uneven, full of little bumps. Since those are completely different, Rough is the opposite of Smooth!
quests.funFact: Ocean waves slowly smooth out rough rocks into round, gentle pebbles!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Deep"? (the middle of the ocean vs. a splashy wading pool)
quests.question: Deep
quests.hint: Here's a clue: where a diver would need special equipment to explore safely. That describes the exact opposite of "Deep"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: deep means going down very far, and shallow means only going down a little way — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: The deepest part of the ocean is deeper than Mount Everest is tall!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Long"? (a giraffe's stretched-out neck vs. a stubby little pencil)
quests.question: Long
quests.hint: Think about which takes longer to read, a single sentence or a whole chapter. What's the opposite of "Long"?
quests.explanation: "Long" means stretching a great distance. "Short" means not stretching very far at all. Since those are completely different, Short is the opposite of Long!
quests.funFact: A blue whale's tongue alone can weigh as much as an elephant!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Fix"? (gluing a cracked toy back together vs. a vase falling and shattering)
quests.question: Fix
quests.hint: Think about what a mechanic does to a car that won't start. What's the opposite of "Fix"?
quests.explanation: "Fix" means to make something work again. "Break" means to make something stop working. Since those are completely different, Break is the opposite of Fix!
quests.funFact: Many toys can be fixed with a little glue and a lot of patience!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Inside"? (a cozy living room vs. a sunny backyard)
quests.question: Inside
quests.hint: Think about where you'd go to stay dry during a rainstorm. What's the opposite of "Inside"?
quests.explanation: "Inside" means in the space within something. "Outside" means in the open space beyond something. Since those are completely different, Outside is the opposite of Inside!
quests.funFact: Many animals, like bears, spend the winter resting inside a warm den!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "True"? (a fact checked in an encyclopedia vs. a made-up rumor)
quests.question: True
quests.hint: Think about what you would call a fact after checking it in a book. What's the opposite of "True"?
quests.explanation: "True" means really did happen, or really is correct. "False" means did not happen, or is not correct. Since those are completely different, False is the opposite of True!
quests.funFact: Scientists test ideas again and again to find out what is really true!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Same"? (two matching mittens vs. two mismatched socks)
quests.question: Same
quests.hint: Think about what you call two puzzle pieces that fit in the exact same spot. What's the opposite of "Same"?
quests.explanation: "Same" means exactly alike in every way. "Different" means not alike in some way. Since those are completely different, Different is the opposite of Same!
quests.funFact: No two snowflakes that have ever fallen are exactly the same shape!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Straight"? (a ruler-straight road vs. a wiggly mountain trail)
quests.question: Straight
quests.hint: Here's a clue: which path a train track usually follows across flat land. That describes the exact opposite of "Straight"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: straight means going in one direction with no bends, and crooked means bending and turning many times — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Lightning bolts zigzag because hot air makes their path bend and twist!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "More"? (a full bucket of blocks vs. a bucket with only a few)
quests.question: More
quests.hint: Think about which slice you'd choose if you were extra hungry. What's the opposite of "More"?
quests.explanation: "More" means a bigger amount of something. "Less" means a smaller amount of something. Since those are completely different, Less is the opposite of More!
quests.funFact: A giant redwood tree can have more leaves than you could ever count!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Above"? (a parachute floating over the clouds vs. fish swimming under the waves)
quests.question: Above
quests.hint: Think about where a bird flies compared to where a fish swims. What's the opposite of "Above"?
quests.explanation: "Above" means in a higher position than something. "Below" means in a lower position than something. Since those are completely different, Below is the opposite of Above!
quests.funFact: Airplanes usually fly high above the clouds to have a smoother ride!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Neat"? (a perfectly made bed vs. clothes tossed everywhere)
quests.question: Neat
quests.hint: Think about how a bedroom looks right after you clean it, not before. What's the opposite of "Neat"?
quests.explanation: "Neat" means tidy, with everything in its place. "Messy" means cluttered, with things scattered around. Since those are completely different, Messy is the opposite of Neat!
quests.funFact: Some scientists say a little bit of mess can actually spark creative ideas!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Laugh"? (a giggling face at a funny joke vs. teary eyes after a sad movie)
quests.question: Laugh
quests.hint: Think about what you do when you hear a really silly joke. What's the opposite of "Laugh"?
quests.explanation: "Laugh" means to make a happy, giggling sound. "Cry" means to let tears fall when you're upset. Since those are completely different, Cry is the opposite of Laugh!
quests.funFact: Laughing can burn a tiny bit of energy, just like a short walk does!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Early"? (the very first one at the bus stop vs. the last one running to catch it)
quests.question: Early
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what you'd call arriving before everyone else, not after. That describes the exact opposite of "Early"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: early means before the expected time, and late means after the expected time — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: The early bird really does catch the worm — worms come out at dawn!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Easy"? (a four-piece puzzle vs. a thousand-piece puzzle)
quests.question: Easy
quests.hint: Think about which puzzle a first-grader could finish in one minute. What's the opposite of "Easy"?
quests.explanation: "Easy" means simple to do without much effort. "Difficult" means hard to do, needing lots of effort. Since those are completely different, Difficult is the opposite of Easy!
quests.funFact: Something difficult at first can feel easy once you've practiced it a lot!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Give"? (handing a friend a present vs. grabbing a cookie from the jar)
quests.question: Give
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what you do with a birthday gift you picked out for a friend. That describes the exact opposite of "Give"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: give means to hand something to someone, and take means to grab something for yourself — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Giving a gift to a friend often feels just as good as receiving one!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Sunny"? (a bright sky with not one cloud vs. a sky full of gray rain clouds)
quests.question: Sunny
quests.hint: Think about the kind of day you'd need an umbrella for. What's the opposite of "Sunny"?
quests.explanation: "Sunny" means full of bright sunshine. "Rainy" means full of falling raindrops. Since those are completely different, Rainy is the opposite of Sunny!
quests.funFact: Rainbows appear when sunshine and raindrops both happen at once!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Buy"? (a shopper handing over coins vs. a shopkeeper handing over a toy)
quests.question: Buy
quests.hint: Think about what you do at a store when you want a new toy to take home. What's the opposite of "Buy"?
quests.explanation: "Buy" means to give money to get something. "Sell" means to give something to get money. Since those are completely different, Sell is the opposite of Buy!
quests.funFact: Long ago, people traded goods for other goods before coins were even invented!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Begin"? (the starting line of a race vs. the finish-line ribbon)
quests.question: Begin
quests.hint: Think about what a story's first sentence does compared to its final one. What's the opposite of "Begin"?
quests.explanation: "Begin" means the very first part of something. "End" means the very last part of something. Since those are completely different, End is the opposite of Begin!
quests.funFact: Every single book, movie, and song has to begin before it can end!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Light"? (a sunny meadow at noon vs. a moonless midnight sky)
quests.question: Light
quests.hint: Think about why you flip on a lamp when you walk into a shadowy room. What's the opposite of "Light"?
quests.explanation: "Light" means bright, so you can see clearly. "Dark" means dim, so it's hard to see. Since those are completely different, Dark is the opposite of Light!
quests.funFact: Some deep caves are so dark that plants can't grow inside them at all!
